summary: Monster Beverage Corp filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) announcing a 2-for-1 stock split effected as a 100% stock dividend. Record date is July 24, 2026; distribution after close on August 10, 2026; trading begins split-adjusted on August 11, 2026. No price, premium, advisor, or structural complexity applies. This routine capital-actions filing does not constitute a special situation as defined.
